propositions: Three landed file-impact states—undeclared, paths, none—lack complete unified documentation across four reader-facing sources and public CLI output

FILE_IMPACT events replace all three derived fields (file_impact list, file_impact_scope value, no_file_impact_reason string) according to target state with specific clearing semantics for each transition

The no-file-impact plan-review criterion is advisory, applies only to authenticated none declarations, and requires an author reason explaining both why no repository files change and where output or evidence lives
Public `rebar explain plan` command must communicate the tri-state contract, the set-file-impact command syntax, that docs-only and test-only work use paths, and the advisory LLM review behavior

Standalone documentation in gate, ticket-model, event-schema, and packaged guide must agree on undeclared-as-unscoped, paths-as-dependency-scoped, and none-as-authenticated-empty semantics with no source-text grep or snapshot-test coupling
